messages:
Alex R: Heads-up — we're seeing a memory slab GC spike on serve-nginx-us-east causing transient GPU OOMs and 502s for embeddings endpoints. Notifying incidents.
SRE Bot: Alert fired: /alerts/serve-memory-spike (sev2) — automated diagnostics running.
Maria C: Investigating now. I'm throttling embed-store read workers for affected shard. @Oncall Sam can you confirm a rolling restart for the us-east embed-worker pool?
Oncall Sam: Ack. Kicking off coordinated rolling restart, 3 nodes at a time to keep steady throughput. ETA ~15m.
Jordan K: Enabled KV cache read-only fallback for impacted routes to reduce embed-store pressure. Also applied temporary rate-limit reductions for anonymous traffic on embeddings.
Alex R: Mitigation steps in flight. Customer impact: elevated 5xx and latency for embeddings in us-east only. Posting status page update shortly.
Statuspage Bot: Statuspage updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/190-embed-read-spike — Partial degradation affecting embeddings in US-East.
Maria C: After the first wave of restarts error rate dropped from ~9% -> 1.2% on /v1/embeddings. Seeing occasional micro-spikes when large prefix requests hit.
Oncall Sam: All restarts complete. Memory and CPU trending down across the pool. Pinning autoscaler for 30m to avoid aggressive scale churn.
Alex R: Quick action items: 1) Postmortem owner: Maria C; 2) Add slab GC tuning to infra sprint; 3) Evaluate pre-warming embed caches for high-QPS customers. I'll coordinate customer comms with product.
Jordan K: If support surfaces incidents, please use the ticket template: 'service: embeddings, region: us-east, symptom: 5xx/latency, start: <ts>, end: <ts>, impact: partial'. Link customers to status page.
Maria C: Saving heapdumps and GC traces to gs://redwood-ops/incident-1912345678/ for postmortem. Will attach graphs and diff of slab metrics.
Alex R: Thanks everyone. Closing this broadcast for now — will reopen if we see regressions or when postmortem is ready. :thumbsup:
